hypothesis: Split three-product Fq2 arithmetic into two Comba product phases. Form D=A-B and S=-(A+B), finish real REDC, then accumulate C into S and finish imaginary REDC. Unlike prior shared row-CIOS, input sums and both cancellation chains need not coexist for all five rows. Rust arithmetic/dataflow change, no tuning sweep.
identity: A=a0*b0, B=a1*b1, C=(a0+a1)*(b0+b1); real=REDC(A-B)+p modulo p, imaginary=REDC(C-A-B).
scope: Private native field component only; no production dispatch, no SDK latency or Gnark export claim. Actual inlined G2 caller and verified complete SDK are required in a separately declared follow-up before adoption, even if this component passes.

bounds.inputs: normalized nonnegative radix52 limbs, values at most2p, p<2^254; radicesR256/R260
bounds.exact_sums: a0+a1,b0+b1<=4p<2^256; never reduce modulo p before raw third product
bounds.real: -4p^2<=A-B<=4p^2; signed REDC plusp in(0,3p), conditional subtract2p leaves[0,2p)
bounds.imaginary: C-A-B=a0*b1+a1*b0 in[0,8p^2]; REDC in[0,3p), conditional subtract2p leaves[0,2p)
bounds.signed_coefficient: raw product coefficient<9B, signed sum magnitude<18B, at most10B from all cancellation lo/hi terms plus carries gives conservative32B bound before final R256 packing; packed/bias coefficients<2^62
bounds.caveat: Logical phase boundaries do not force LLVM register lifetimes. Inspect exact generated machine code; no predicted spill or stack gain is a measurement.

validation.arkworks_oracle: Boundary/lazy inputs including2p; independently evaluate all complex outputs and repeated chains, check normalized limbs and strict2p result bound.
validation.integer_oracle: Model exact signed convolution/cancellation and compare raw SIMD output to exact BigInt REDC representative, recording coefficient bounds.

benchmark.rotation: Rotate all16pattern/variant observations per block, reverse odd blocks.
benchmark.output_checks: Every final canonical u64 word equal to accepted across all blocks; no checksum-only check.

promotion: Component pass only authorizes a separately frozen caller/SDK trial, never automatic adoption.
reporting: Retain successful/failed commands, hashes, all measurements, raw profiles locally. Commit and push completed experiment including negatives before another experiment.
